build_task_with_define_task_decorator: build a PHYRE task using the @creator_lib.define_task decorator to register a spatial reasoning task
create_box_with_add_box: create a box in the PHYRE scene using C.add_box with specified width and height dimensions
position_box_with_set_bottom_set_left: position a PHYRE box by calling set_bottom and set_left to set its coordinates
update_task_with_spatial_relationship: update the PHYRE task with body references, spatial relationships like BELOW, and a description string
review_build_task_function: review the build_task function that defines two boxes and checks if the smaller box is below the bigger box
